title: Type Safety Patterns
description: Build type-safe APIs, use discriminated unions, type guards, and brand types for enhanced type safety.

data.text: Discriminated unions use a common property to distinguish between types. Type guards narrow types at runtime. Brand types prevent accidental type coercion.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Discriminated unions distinguish types with a common property
Type guards narrow types with runtime checks
Brand types prevent accidental type coercion
Exhaustive checking ensures all cases are handled
Strict mode catches more errors at compile time
data.takeaway: Type safety patterns prevent entire classes of bugs. Use discriminated unions for state machines, type guards for runtime validation, and brand types for opaque types.
